title: Kgakololo e e Gabilweng mo Botlhaleng
intro: Akanya fela o eme fa thoko ga setshwantsho se se sa itsiweng ka dikgakgamatso kgotsa magosi, mme se itsege ka mafoko a a sa ntseng a kaela dipelo gompieno. Motlhanka yono wa ga Allah o ne a amogela mpho e e botlhokwa mme a tshololela tebogo mo kgakololong nngwe le nngwe e e neng e newa moithuti yo mmotlana yo o rategang.
clues: Ke ne ke segofaditswe ke Allah ka botlhale, mme ke ne ka laelwa go bo lebogela.
Ke ne ka bua le morwaake ka kgakololo e e bonolo, ke tlhagisa ka lorato le kamego.
Ke ne ka bolelela morwaake gore go amanya balekane le Allah ke phoso e kgolo thata.
Ke ne ka gakolola morwaake gore a tlhome thapelo, a laele se se siameng, a thibele se se sa siamang le go itshoka ka bopelotelele.
Ke ne ka tlhagisa morwaake gore a se ka a retolola lerama ka boikgogomoso le fa e le go tsamaya mo lefatsheng ka boikgogomoso.
Ke ne ka ruta morwaake go tsamaya ka lobelo lo lo itekanetseng le go fokotsa lentswe, ka gonne medumo e e bogale go gaisa tsotlhe ke go lela ga ditonki.

trial.answer: Go gakolola ngwanake kgatlhanong le go amana le Allah

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
